title: Battle of Halai
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Halai", at revision 1370442477, opens: "The Battle of Halai, or the Battle of Halay, which took place in December 1894 was a battle between an Eritrean rebel force under Bahta Hagos and the Italian army." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q18164954, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1894 battle of the First Italo-Ethiopian War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
